code.$description: Role 4, code: code, keys and tabular identifiers. Left unset, it stays on the system monospace (a proportional face never sets code)

axes.$description: Variable-font axis settings per font role (F16), as CSS font-variation-settings: normal (the face's defaults) unless the theme tunes an axis the face has

xs.$description: Ramp xs (12 px): fine print beside a figure; never running text

overlay.$description: Dialogs and sheets over a scrim

shimmer.$description: ui-states: one shimmer pass of a skeleton

shimmer-passes.$description: ui-states: shimmer passes before a skeleton goes still

size-56.$description: Size l: l list rows with pictures

size-128.$description: The largest: a profile editor or a people directory card

initials-scale.$description: Initials' font size as a share of the avatar's size, so the letters scale with the circle at every size

initials-scale-s.$description: The single initial's share at 16 and 20 px (8 and 10 px), so it stays readable

initials-weight.$description: Initials' weight: heavier than body so two letters read at 16 px

icon-scale.$description: The fallback icon's size as a share of the avatar's size

square-scale.$description: A rounded square's corner radius as a share of its size (5 px at 32, 19 px at 128), so the corner looks the same at every size

ring-gap.$description: The surface-coloured gap between the avatar and its activity ring

ring-width.$description: The activity ring's stroke (active, speaking, a new story)

overlap-scale.$description: How much each avatar in a stack hides under the next, as a share of its size: enough to read as one group, little enough that every face shows

cut.$description: The surface-coloured cut around each stacked avatar, so overlapping faces stay apart

spread-gap.$description: Between avatars laid out side by side (spread)

gap.$description: Between the avatar and the words beside it

gap-below.$description: Between the avatar and the words under it (text below)

gap.$description: Between slides, and between the slides and the controls under them

radius.$description: A slide's corners

peek-share.$description: With peek, a slide's width as a share of the carousel, so a tenth of each neighbour shows on either side

peek-opacity.$description: A peeking neighbour's opacity: present, clearly not the slide being shown

peek-scale.$description: A peeking neighbour drawn a little smaller (a transform: its box and the snap points never change)

dot.$description: A picker dot (8 px), drawn inside its own 24 px target

dot-active.$description: The current slide's dot drawn out into a pill (24 px), inside the same target, so the other dots never move

thumb.$description: A thumbnail in the thumbnails picker (56 px)

ratio.$description: A slide's shape when its content doesn't set one (16:9)

interval.$description: How long each slide shows while rotating by itself: long enough to read a caption twice

gap.$description: Between a separator and the page name after it, and between one step and the next separator

step.$description: A step's least height (24 px), so wrapped lines keep their links a minimum target apart

size.$description: The path's text: one step smaller than the page's body, so it reads as wayfinding, not content

gap.$description: Between tabs: small, so the set reads as one group

item-size.$description: A tab's least height (44 px target)

item-size-xs.$description: A tab's least height at size xs (24 px): a dense panel's tabs (an inspector), by the written dense-surface exception

item-size-s.$description: A tab's least height at size s (36 px)

item-padding-inline.$description: Inside a tab, at its start and end; the indicator sits within it

item-padding-inline-sm.$description: Inside a tab at sizes xs and s, so a dense panel's tabs fit its width

gap-sm.$description: Between tabs at sizes xs and s: a dense panel's three tabs fit a 240 px column

item-gap.$description: Between a tab's icon, name and count

radius.$description: A tab's corners, seen only on hover, press and the vertical selected fill

indicator.$description: The selected tab's indicator: a rounded bar of its own under the name, as wide as the tab's content, never a border of the tab

indicator-fill.$description: The indicator's colour; a theme that marks the selected tab with a fill may clear it (F15.FR5)

selected-fill.$description: A quiet fill behind the selected tab: none by default (the indicator marks it); a theme may set one, as pill tabs (F15.FR5)

panel-gap.$description: Between the tabs and the panel under them

panel-gap-section.$description: Between the tabs and a panel of grouped sections (gap="section"), so the space around the groups is never smaller than inside them

side-gap.$description: Between vertical tabs and the panel beside them

gap.$description: Between pages: small, so the numbers read as one row

group-gap.$description: Between the total, the pages and the size changer

step-padding-inline.$description: Inside Previous and Next, at their start and end

radius.$description: A page's corners, seen on hover, press and the current page's fill

sequence-gap.$description: Between a neighbour's direction and its title

margin.$description: Least space between the dialog and the window's edges, above the narrow width

radius.$description: The dialog's corners; square when it fills a narrow window

padding.$description: Inside the header, the body's scroll content and the actions: one inset for all three, so their edges line up

gap.$description: Between the header, the body and the actions (as padding at their shared edges)

heading-gap.$description: Between the title and the description

rise.$description: How far the dialog rises as it opens (a transform; nothing behind it moves)

palette-width.$description: A palette's width: results beside a preview; smaller in a small window

palette-height.$description: A palette's fixed height, so it holds still while its results change; smaller in a short window

palette-top.$description: The least space above a palette (clear of an app's top bar); in a tall window it sits a fifth of the way down

aside.$description: The start column's width when ratio is aside (a heading beside its content, IP20); the end column takes the rest. Below two columns' width the two stack

section-gap.$description: Between rows of cells that are sections (gap section: a split or grid block's sections when stacked, DP11): a step wider than the space inside a section and narrower than the page gap, so the sections read as one group (spacing SC3)

gap.$description: Between the words and the picture, stacked or side by side, and between the words and the actions when divided

trail-gap.$description: Between the opening (words and picture or media) and its trail (IP19): a step wider than the gap inside the opening and narrower than the page gap after the hero, so the trail reads as the opening's last part (spacing SC3)

words-gap.$description: Between the message (heading and lead) and what to do (actions and note): the section level (Q85)

message-gap.$description: Between the heading block and the lead (Q85)

heading-gap.$description: Between the eyebrow and the title

doing-gap.$description: Between the actions and the note under them: wider than the actions' own rows when they wrap, so the note reads as one more part (spacing SC3)

stacked-words-gap.$description: Narrow (stacked): between the message and what to do. A stacked hero sits a page level from the next unit, so its levels step down once to keep each wider than the one inside it (spacing SC3)

stacked-message-gap.$description: Narrow (stacked): between the heading block and the lead

stacked-doing-gap.$description: Narrow (stacked): between the actions and the note

stacked-actions-row-gap.$description: Narrow (stacked): between rows of actions when they wrap

lead-size.$description: The lead: one step above body, as PageHeader's

measure.$description: Widest the title and lead run, so they stay readable

split-min.$description: The narrowest the words and the picture each get side by side; narrower, they stack

padding-block.$description: Above and below the footer's content, inside its sunken surface

padding-inline.$description: At the footer's start and end: the page margin, so its words line up with the page's

gap.$description: Between the link sections and the small print: the footer's two groups

column-gap.$description: Between link sections side by side, and between rows of them

column-min.$description: The narrowest a link section gets before the sections wrap to fewer columns

heading-gap.$description: Between a section's heading and its links

link-gap.$description: Between the links of one section

links-column-min.$description: A two-column section (FooterSection.columns = 2): the narrowest a column of links gets before the section falls back to one column

meta-gap.$description: Between the small-print links, the identity line and the legal line

meta-link-gap.$description: Between small-print links in their wrapping row

identity-width.$description: IP33: the identity column at arrangement="identity", beside the link sections (it stacks above them below 40 rem of footer)

max-width.$description: The widest a pill grows (about 560 px); on a narrow window, the window less the edge space

edge.$description: Between the pills and the window's bottom and side edges

gap.$description: Between pills in the stack, and above the waiting count

padding-block.$description: Above and below a pill's row; with its 44 px least height, one line sits centred

padding-inline.$description: At a pill's start and end, so the words clear its rounded ends

content-gap.$description: Between the status icon, the message, the count, the action and Close

height.$description: A pill's least height: one line with its buttons (44 px)

radius.$description: The pill's corners: more than half a one-line pill's height, so one line reads as a pill and two or three as a rounded box

rise.$description: How far a pill rises as it enters (a transform; nothing moves); only a fade under reduced motion

layer.$description: The region's stacking order where the top layer isn't supported

radius.$description: An inline or section alert's corners; a page banner runs edge to edge and stays square

padding-block.$description: Above and below an alert's content, once, on its one tinted surface

padding-inline.$description: At an inline or section alert's start and end

page-padding-inline.$description: At a page banner's start and end: the page margin, so its words line up with the page's

gap.$description: Between the status icon, the words and Close

content-gap.$description: Between the title and the description: one message reads as one group

actions-gap.$description: Between an alert's actions, and between the words and the actions beside them

actions-space.$description: Above the actions when they sit under the words (section and page placements)

words-min.$description: An inline alert's words keep at least this width beside its actions; narrower, the actions move under the words

min-block-view.$description: The least height of an empty view's content area, so the page keeps its shape

min-block-section.$description: The least height of an empty section, card or panel

padding-view.$description: Around an empty view's message, once

padding-section.$description: Around an empty section's message, once

padding-component.$description: Around an empty menu's, picker's or side list's one line

gap.$description: Between the heading and the reason: one message

actions-space.$description: Above the actions, and between the silhouette and the message

words-max.$description: The widest the reason runs, so it reads as a short paragraph in a wide view

silhouette-width.$description: The width of the faint outline of the content to come

silhouette-gap.$description: Between the silhouette's rows or tiles

actions-space-section.$description: A section's empty message: above the actions and between the silhouette and the message, closer than the section's parts sit apart (spacing SC3)

silhouette-gap-section.$description: A section's empty message: between the silhouette's rows or tiles, closer than the silhouette sits to the message

silhouette-row.$description: One silhouette row's height, like a list row's

zone-min-block.$description: The drop area's least height (80 px): a target big enough to drop on

zone-gap.$description: Between the upload icon, the words and Choose files; also between rows when they wrap

gap.$description: Between the drop area (or the button) and the list of files

list-gap.$description: Between files in the list: space alone separates them

item-gap.$description: Between a file's icon, its words and its buttons

item-line-gap.$description: Between a file's name, its progress and its status line

gap.$description: Between the time's parts and AM/PM inside the field box

segment-padding.$description: At each side of one part, so its fill when focused clears the digits

parts-gap.$description: Between the day, month and year boxes of a separate date

label-gap.$description: Between a box's small label (Day, Month, Year) and the box

part-width.$description: A day or month box: room for two digits, or a short month name, with the field's padding

year-width.$description: The year box: room for four digits with the field's padding

width-s.$description: A narrow side sheet: filters, a short list

width-m.$description: A side sheet for details or a short form (default)

width-l.$description: A wide side sheet: a longer form or a preview

top-gap.$description: Least page left in view above a bottom sheet at its tallest

radius.$description: The sheet's corners on the side facing the page; the edge it comes from stays square

padding.$description: Inside the header, the body's scroll content and the actions: one inset for all three, so their edges line up

gap.$description: Between the header, the body and the actions (as padding at their shared edges)

heading-gap.$description: Between the title and the description

tools-gap.$description: Between the header's icon buttons and Close

layer.$description: A standard (non-modal) sheet's stacking layer: over the page, below dialogs; modal sheets are in the top layer

radius.$description: An outlined card's corners, and a plain card's picture

padding.$description: Inside an outlined card's words, once; the picture bleeds to its edges

gap.$description: Inside the message (the heading and the description), between the parts of the content, and between the facts and the actions

body-gap.$description: Between the message, the content and the footer: a group apart, never more than the card's inset (Q85)

heading-gap.$description: Between the eyebrow and the title

beside-min.$description: The narrowest the picture and the words may each be side by side; narrower, they stack

row-media.$description: A row card's square picture (80 px)

gap.$description: Between the label, the figure, the trend line and the change: one statistic reads as one group

value-size-m.$description: The figure in a row of statistics

value-size-l.$description: The one figure a view leads with

unit-gap.$description: Between the figure and its unit

change-gap.$description: Between the change's icon, its amount and the period

trend-height.$description: The trend line's height; it takes the statistic's width

trigger-size.$description: A heading button's least height (44 px target)

trigger-padding-block.$description: Above and below a heading's words inside its button

trigger-padding-inline.$description: At a heading button's start and end, so its hover fill doesn't touch the words

trigger-gap.$description: Between a heading's words and its chevron

title-gap.$description: Between a heading and its summary line

panel-padding.$description: At an open section's start and end (lined up with the heading's words) and under its content

radius.$description: A heading button's corners, seen only on hover and press

controls-gap.$description: Between Show all sections and the list

radius.$description: A picture's corners, on the picture itself

caption-gap.$description: Between a figure's picture and its caption

credit-gap.$description: Between the caption and the credit after it

fallback-gap.$description: Between the icon and the words of a picture that couldn't load

fallback-padding.$description: Inside the frame of a picture that couldn't load, around its words

duotone.$description: IP31: the colour a duotone picture's light parts take, its dark parts staying near black (the picture in grey, multiplied over this fill). A brand sets it with applySettings

decoration.$description: MP8: the text colour of a picture's decoration and under layers, so shapes drawn in currentColor take the brand's accent in every scheme. A brand sets it with applySettings

reveal-duration.$description: MP11: how long a drawn reveal (Image reveal) takes from the picture to its pair, on the standard easing; it runs back as long

reveal-reduced-duration.$description: LR26: with reduced motion a reveal isn't drawn; the pair crossfades in over the resting tone for this long. A brand sets it with applySettings

ink.$description: MP20, ID41: the role class ink, an illustration's lines and main shapes; follows every scheme. A template re-points it

muted.$description: MP20, ID41: the role class muted, secondary lines and shapes (3:1 or more on the surface)

fill.$description: MP20, ID41: the role class fill, quiet areas behind the drawing

surface.$description: MP20, ID41: the role class surface, shapes that read as the page itself (a cut-out, a card in the drawing)

accent.$description: MP20, ID41: the role class accent, the one brand-coloured part; a brand sets it with applySettings

play-duration.$description: MP21, ID43: one pass of a part that draws itself or fades in (data-motion draw, fade), on the standard easing

loop-duration.$description: MP21, ID43: one cycle of a part that floats, pulses or spins; slow, so it reads as ambient. Never played under reduced motion

float.$description: MP21: how far a floating part rises; 0 with reduced motion

control-inset.$description: MP21: from the illustration's corner to its Pause control

radius.$description: The player's corners, on the video or poster itself

caption-gap.$description: Between the player and its caption, and between an audio player's title and its controls

badge-inset.$description: Between a poster's length badge and the poster's corner

screen-gap.$description: Least of the window left around a tall (portrait) video, which narrows rather than grow taller than the window

audio-width.$description: Widest an audio player grows: its seek bar stays usable without running across a page

gap.$description: Between pictures: small, so the set reads as one

framed-gap.$description: Between framed pictures (framed): the usual gap, since each picture keeps its art's room in its own box (Image room); a template whose art reads crowded sets more

min.$description: The narrowest column in standard and masonry; fewer columns as the place narrows

cell.$description: The narrowest square cell in quilted

row.$description: A justified row's starting height; rows stretch a little to fill the width

hover-opacity.$description: A picture that opens, under the pointer: a little lighter, nothing moves

mark-inset.$description: Between a picture's marks (check box, badges, a video's length) and its corners

selection-width.$description: A chosen picture's outline width, drawn inside its edge

dragging-opacity.$description: Pictures being dragged out of the grid (onItemsDragStart), left in place: present, clearly being moved

drop.$description: The line in the gap where reordered pictures would land (reorderable)

padding.$description: Inside the window's edges, around the bar, the stage and the caption

gap.$description: Between the bar, the stage and the caption

side-gap.$description: Between Previous or Next and the picture

gap.$description: Between the quoted words and who they're from

paragraph-gap.$description: Between the paragraphs of a longer quote

attribution-gap.$description: Between the author and the source under them

text-size-s.$description: A quote in a card or beside other content

text-size-m.$description: A quote set apart inside an article

text-size-l.$description: The one quote a section leads with, in the display face

measure.$description: The widest a centred quote's lines run, so they stay readable

list-narrow.$description: The list's column for a name and a short line (default)

list-wide.$description: The list's column for a name and two lines under it (an inbox)

gutter.$description: Between the list and the detail: space alone separates them, no line

back-gap.$description: Between Back and the detail it returns from, when one side shows at a time

max-md.$description: maxSize="md": the most the layout grows before each side scrolls on its own

gap.$description: Between a page's header and its sections, and between sections: the page level, so each section reads as its own group (Q85)

rest-scale.$description: The thumb at rest is drawn at this share of its hovered thickness (4 of 8 px); hover and drag scale it to full, so its geometry never changes

thumb-hover.$description: The thumb's full thickness (8 px), shown while its track is hovered or it is dragged; at rest it is scaled by rest-scale

thumb-min.$description: The shortest a thumb gets, however long the content (24 px), so it can always be grabbed

track.$description: The strip that takes the pointer (12 px), over the region's end edge

track-inset.$description: Between the track's ends and the region's corners, so the thumb never meets a rounded corner

radius.$description: The thumb's ends; square under the sharp shape option

colour.$description: The thumb at rest: 3:1 on the canvas and the raised and sunken surfaces in every context

colour-active.$description: The thumb while hovered or dragged

fade.$description: The thumb fading in and out in the shown-on-scroll mode; 0 under reduced motion

idle.$description: How long the thumb stays after the last scroll in the shown-on-scroll mode

max-sm.$description: maxSize="sm": the most the region grows before it scrolls

inset-sm.$description: inset="sm": padding on the content inside the scroll box, never on the box

surface.$description: surface="sunken": the fill that shows a region's bounds when no surface of its own does

linear.$description: Even pace (Q65 T9): determinate progress fills, loops, and the outgoing layer of a cross-fade

enter-scale.$description: Q65 T11: a popover or menu grows from this scale at its anchor as it arrives; 1 with reduced motion (it only fades)

mark-scale.$description: Q65 C5: a checkbox mark or radio dot is drawn at this size in the first frame and settles to full size over duration.quick; 1 with reduced motion

zoom-scale.$description: Q65 C21: a zoom between levels (a calendar's month, year and decade views): zooming out, the new level arrives from the inverse (larger) and the old leaves to this; zooming in, the reverse. 1 with reduced motion (the levels only cross-fade)

dialog-scale.$description: Q65 T11: a dialog grows from this scale as it opens; 1 with reduced motion (it only fades)

enter-rise.$description: Q65 T11: the furthest an arriving surface travels (a pill rising from the bottom, a step's content shifting); 0 with reduced motion

glide-far.$description: MP13: with glide pace distance, a scroll at least this long takes duration.move-far; a shorter one takes duration.move (timing, not travel: reduced motion jumps either way)

behind.$description: Behind its siblings, inside a component that isolates its own stacking (a SegmentedControl segment's fill); never leaks out

base.$description: Page content: everything in normal flow

raised.$description: Over its neighbours inside an isolated component (a selected or focused part that overlaps the next); never leaks out

sticky.$description: Sticky headers, held table columns, the skip link

popover.$description: Menus, listboxes and popovers; in the browser's top layer where popover is supported, so this is the fallback order

devtools.$description: Review tooling over the page (the element picker's glass, boxes and label): above content and popups, below the pane sheet so the pane stays usable

overlay.$description: Scrims and non-modal sheets over the page (the revision pane below the breakpoint)

dialog.$description: Modal dialogs and sheets; in the top layer as dialog elements, so this is the fallback order

toast.$description: Notification pills: above dialogs, so a result is never hidden by what caused it

tooltip.$description: Tooltips: always on top, short-lived and never interactive

xs.$description: Extra small: phones held upright; a dialog, a lightbox and a sheet fill the window below it

md.$description: Medium: tablets and small laptops; navigation becomes a side region

lg.$description: Large: desktops; room for an inspector region
